name: Manual format shift/scale (EmberFrame)
plain: Explicit Flux-style shift and scale in both directions as a node, for moving between ComfyUI's stored latent form and what a Pi-Flow-like tool expects.
math: comfy_to_pid: (x−shift)·scale; pid_to_comfy: x/scale+shift; defaults scale 0.3611, shift 0.1159
label: from code

audit.note: Default order invites a swap: formula names shift first, then 'defaults 0.3611, 0.1159'. nodes.py:494-495: scale_factor is 0.3611, shift_factor is 0.1159.
